title: SaliMory：为对话代理编排认知记忆
summary: SALIMORY框架通过训练单一语言模型管理认知结构化的记忆（用户事实、偏好和工作记忆），引入分层阶段过程奖励和奖励分解对比细化，为不同记忆操作提供端到端独立监督。相比现有方法，将记忆相关失败减少三分之一，端到端准确率提升超10%，个性化率翻倍。
summary_en: SALIMORY trains a single language model to manage cognitively-structured memory (user facts, preferences, working memory) using hierarchical stage-wise process reward and reward-decomposed contrastive refinement. It cuts memory-attributed failures by one-third, outperforms SOTA by over 10% in accuracy, and more than doubles personalization rate.
